mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2.5%) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) increases discount rates applied to equity cash flows, reducing present value and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite high rate signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST > 900) and retail sales (RSAFS > 350000) signals robust consumer demand, increasing corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS exceed thresholds, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is negative.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) triggers Federal Reserve monetary easing, which lowers discount rates and increases equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 5.0), or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A real GDP level (GDPC1 > 11000) signals strong economic growth, increasing corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in high-GDP periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate earnings growth and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (INDPRO < 100), or the signal's Rank IC is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 210) signal a monetary tightening cycle, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL exceed thresholds, or the Rank IC for the interaction is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS > 137000) generates robust income growth, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (PAYEMS > 137000), or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03.
